name: fail_closed_on_learning
justification: It is an explicit operating-mode decision that directly constrains learning behavior. The choice is stable and enforceable.

name: safe_fallback_on_input
justification: It defines how the system behaves under malformed input and therefore affects future system decisions. The operating-mode choice is explicit and stable.

name: safe normalization of partial or malformed input
description: Input expectation states the service receives a JSON object that may be partial or malformed, and the safe normalization rules define wrapper filling and safe blocked fallback values instead of external rejection.
justification: This is an explicit structural decision about how the pipeline handles incomplete input. It is stable, enforceable, and affects downstream decisions.

name: audit routing for non-learning records
description: Blocked, low-trust, quarantined, and duplicate records are routed to audit or storage buckets instead of learning_dataset according to the explicit routing and firewall rules.
justification: It captures a stable routing architecture that governs where non-learning records go. The decision is explicit and operationally enforceable.
